steps.title: Dashboard loads with readiness badge
steps.narration: The application starts on the Dashboard. The readiness badge at the top confirms the backend is ready and responsive to serve data.
steps.point_out: Readiness badge showing 'Ready' status at top of page

steps.title: Data Manager shows current status
steps.narration: The Data Manager page displays the latest run status and the complete history of past backfill jobs. Each entry shows what was completed and what remains.
steps.point_out: Run history panel listing past jobs with their status; last run status showing a real value

steps.title: Zero-work backfill explains itself clearly
steps.narration: When a backfill requests dates that are already fully processed, the system explains this honestly. Here, a weekend-only span is submitted and immediately reports zero work to do.
steps.point_out: Job report showing '0/0 dates' with neutral gray explanation '2 calendar days · 0 already snapshotted · 2 non-trading'

steps.title: Complete the weekend backfill request
steps.narration: The end date is set to complete the weekend span that contains no trading data.
steps.point_out: End date field filled; page ready for job submission

steps.title: Submit and watch the job complete instantly
steps.narration: The Start button triggers the backfill. Since all dates are already snapshotted or non-trading, the job finishes within seconds and reports its work clearly.
steps.point_out: Job card showing completion status and the zero-work explanation displayed in neutral styling

steps.title: Scanner Runs page lists all stored snapshots
steps.narration: The Scanner Runs page shows the complete history of every trading day's snapshot. Each row represents data that has been processed and stored. No range restrictions apply—months-long spans execute to completion.
steps.point_out: Table showing multiple scanner run rows, each with a date as-of value and leaderboard data

steps.title: Backtest page serves results instantly from storage
steps.narration: The Backtest page displays evidence and summary information immediately, without any recomputation delay. All data is served from pre-computed snapshots, staying responsive even during background compute.
steps.point_out: Backtest page with 'Snapshots contributing' text visible immediately upon load

steps.title: All pages remain responsive under load
steps.narration: Every page in the application—Stocks, Sectors, Themes, Evidence, and Regime Lab—loads with real content quickly. The system handles background compute activity without freezing or stalling.
steps.point_out: Navigation through multiple pages works smoothly; no blank pages or spinners; background-compute panel shows real status
